definition.text: The directed movement of mRNA from the nucleus to the cytoplasm.

synonyms.name: mRNA transport from nucleus to cytoplasm

definition.text: Unwinding of an RNA helix, driven by ATP hydrolysis.

results.name: mRNA splicing, via spliceosome

definition.text: The joining together of exons from one or more primary transcripts of messenger RNA (mRNA) and the excision of intron sequences, via a spliceosomal mechanism, so that mRNA consisting only of the joined exons is produced.

results.comment: Note that although the many U12-type introns have the sequence AT-AC at the intron termini, some introns with these terminal sequences are spliced by the U2-type spliceosome. The distinguishing characteristics are sequences near the 5' splice site and the branch point sequences of the intron. Note that although the majority of U2-type introns have the sequence GU-AG at the intron termini, some introns with these terminal sequences are spliced by the U12-type spliceosome. The distinguishing characteristics are sequences near the 5' splice site and the branch point sequences of the intron.

synonyms.name: nuclear mRNA splicing via U12-type spliceosome
nuclear mRNA splicing via U2-type spliceosome
